# rework r5 claims — purchases_returns_and_price_adjustments

- R4-N1 → took option (b). No passage of the charter states a company-wide tax schedule or calls a Finch Note a store discount any more. Every tax figure is apportioned the way the base price-adjustment rule apportions tax, by the unit's selling price:
  - The shelf-price correction and registry price protection tax sentences divide by the selling price again, as the base rule does.
  - The note tax refund is the recorded tax times the undeducted note value over the selling price. Its scope says, as its own case, that the unit was charged tax on a part the note had already paid.
  - The registry-credit, note and gift-card due amounts are each the selling price plus the recorded tax, less the notes on the unit and less the tax on the undeducted note part, apportioned the same way.
  - Swept every tax sentence in the extended charter (rules, baselines, bases, overwrites): none restates or contradicts base tax wording, and no two passages give different tax figures for one situation.
- R4-O1 → the note tax refund's courtesy layer was scaled to a size proportionate to a small tax correction. Its factor count and floors are kept, and every factor still bears weight. The note shortfall refund's courtesy for the same note is unchanged; the two refunds now compensate visibly different quantities at different scales.
- Seeds → unchanged; the recorded tax on the note-paid purchases is a record, which no passage now judges against a schedule.
- Probes → on scratch copies the figures behave as the rules state:
  - closed or expired second records listed first change no figure;
  - a unit fully paid by notes evaluates without error;
  - a correctly applied note yields no note or tax shortfall;
  - a correctly recorded mixed-tender unit yields no second capture and no shortfall.
- Proof text → task 1's rationale, traces, argument tracing and closure were rebuilt from re-run computations. Task 0's rationale log was reworded to match the charter; its world and figures are unchanged.
- R3-O2, CG-O1, CG-O5, CG-O6, CG-O8 → considered; unchanged.
